name: couchpotato-ui-tests
description: End-to-end and unit tests for CouchPotato htmx UI

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts._comment:test:e2e: Projects named explicitly. A bare `npx playwright test` also selects the `isolation` project, whose pair only demonstrates anything at >= 2 workers -- and playwright.config.ts pins workers: 1 globally, so isolation-b-assert failed EVERY run by construction. That made `npm test`, `npm run test:e2e` and `npm run test:all` red on a green tree. The isolation pair has its own script below, which pins --workers=2. Adding a project to playwright.config.ts means adding it here too; tests/unit/e2e_projects.test.ts fails if the two lists drift.
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:lighthouse
